'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Well-well, you've finished your first assessment. I think it's right about time for a new champion of the Arena to rise. And it's going to be you. By consent, of course. We don't practice cruelty here, haha! I can help you reach heights and riches beyond your wildest dreams. You just have to take me up on my offer. But, you know, actions always trump words. So go ahead, enter the Arena and win. That's how I will know you're ready to push forward.}}

==Objectives==
* Win a match in CheckPoint or LastHero mode in [[Arena]]

==Rewards==
* +2,800 [[EXP]]
* [[Ref]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.02'''</font>

** 58 [[GP coin]]s with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
